protocol.question: Compare GPU hydrogen minimisation and bounded streaming preparation against deterministic CPU repair/H preparation; optimise complete-job throughput, with chemical-geometry checks.

fixed.neural_model: released pLDDT, strict FP32, saved AOT, native writer
fixed.hydrogen_forcefield: Amber ff14SB/GBn2, pH7, seed42, CutoffNonPeriodic as original addHydrogens
fixed.hydrogen_minimisation: original tolerance1.0, max50 iterations; heavy atoms massless

pipeline_screen.panel: 8 retained public benchmark pairs plus 56 distinct native OAS pairs; 64 distinct pairs total
pipeline_screen.selection: Use small-engine evidence to bound the full-pipeline grid; retain failed/worse configurations. Confirm leading conditions on a larger distinct panel if the small screen passes.

geometry.hard_checks: finite coordinates, atom/residue identities, parameterisation, protonation choices, original-heavy preservation under each route
diagnostics: H bond-length errors against force-field targets (>0.05/0.10 Angstrom)
alpha H opposite CB relative N-CA-C plane; flag degenerate heavy geometry
severe H-involving overlaps, excluding pairs within three covalent bonds
same-parent H permutation matching and per-target coordinate changes
geometry.decision: No new severe H bond/alpha-H defect accepted silently; existing baseline defects disclosed. No candidate enabled before user review.

protocol.measurement: Fresh containers; complete-job seconds/throughput. 20ms MemAvailable, 5s pre/8s post, 0.25GiB drift flag; no RSS/CUDA sums. Pipeline events show first preparation vs last raw output; no host interval claimed as device execution.
protocol.retention: No deletions or production branch/image changes; original/modified third-party source and regression tests on component branch; biological inputs/predictions/full atom data stay local.

followup_record_271026.reason: Four GPU workers approached CPU20 throughput, justifying GPU8/12/16/20 concurrency tests; plateau candidates then characterised on128 pairs with both routes. No geometry acceptance inferred.
followup_record_271026.decision: Do not enable GPU hydrogen or streaming; retain full results for review. GPU speed gain confirmed but new chemical defects remain.
followup_record_271026.public_payload: Source, aggregate/per-target numerical summaries under generic IDs, protocols, telemetry and test logs only; no input sequences or predictions.
